summary: Backend regression for Conactivos HR after adding 'Pausas Activas' feature. 33/33 pytest tests PASS (added 6 new tests to TestPausasActivas + all 27 prior regression tests still green). Pausas coverage: (a) GET /api/pausas-activas without auth -> 403; (b) GET /api/pausas-activas/random without auth -> 403; (c) authenticated GET returns exactly 10 items sorted by 'order' 1..10; (d) each item has required fields _id (str), order (int), name, description, focus_area, duration_seconds (>0), instructions (list of >=3 non-empty strings) and image_base64 (non-empty, starts with 'data:image'); (e) GET /api/pausas-activas/random (employee auth) returns a single valid pausa with same shape and 1<=order<=10; (f) POST /api/seed does NOT wipe pausas_activas — count stays 10 before/after re-seed. Regressions confirmed intact: admin & employee login, /auth/me, wrong-password 401, /dashboard/birthdays (Juan today + Laura/Pedro/Sofía/Miguel upcoming with days_until>0, sorted), /dashboard/absent (Pedro medical), /goals (current month 65% $325K/$500K), /dashboard/employee-of-month (Juan Pérez, _id str, no password leak), seed counts (3 admins, 10 employees, 3 leaves, 3 events, 3 capsules, 6 kudos), leave create→approve flow, kudos create + self-kudo 400, admin guards on /reports/stats /events POST /goals PUT (403 for employees, 200 for admins), unauth /reports/stats -> 401/403. One latent backend bug uncovered during testing: server.py uses `except jwt.JWTError` which does not exist in PyJWT and crashes with AttributeError when any non-Expired exception path is hit inside get_current_user (e.g. stale token after seed rebuilds users). Not blocking pausas feature but should be fixed.

minor.issue: `except jwt.JWTError:` is invalid — PyJWT does not expose `jwt.JWTError` (that name belongs to python-jose). When get_current_user hits any error other than ExpiredSignatureError inside the try block (e.g., stale token whose user_id no longer maps to a Mongo document after re-seed, invalid signature, malformed token), Python evaluates `jwt.JWTError` and raises AttributeError → uvicorn returns 500 instead of 401. Repro: login → POST /api/seed (wipes users) → GET /api/pausas-activas with old token → 500. Fix: replace `jwt.JWTError` with `jwt.PyJWTError` (or `jwt.InvalidTokenError`), and add `except HTTPException: raise` before it so raised 401s propagate correctly.

action_items: Fix stale-token/invalid-token 500 in /app/backend/server.py get_current_user: use `except jwt.PyJWTError` (PyJWT) instead of non-existent `jwt.JWTError`, and add `except HTTPException: raise` before the JWT-error catch so 401s from user-not-found propagate as 401 instead of AttributeError-500.
critical_code_review_comments: PausaActiva Pydantic model is defined but the endpoints return raw Mongo dicts (with datetime, ObjectId->str) rather than serializing through the model. This works because pausas documents don't include a `_id` ObjectId issue (converted manually) and no extra fields leak, but for consistency consider `response_model=List[PausaActiva]` on the list endpoint and `response_model=PausaActiva` on random.
GET /api/pausas-activas/random uses count_documents + skip+limit which is O(N) on every request; acceptable for N=10 but consider `$sample` aggregation for larger collections.
Neither pausas endpoint enforces role — both admin and employee can access, which matches the intended UX (any user can view break exercises). No issue, just noting.

rca_of_issue: Bug: get_current_user (server.py:215-232) has `except jwt.JWTError:` — PyJWT (imported as `import jwt`) does not expose `JWTError` (that class is in python-jose). Under happy path (valid token) the except clause is never evaluated, so tests pass. But when the token references a user_id that no longer exists (e.g., after POST /api/seed wipes users), the code path is: jwt.decode succeeds → find_one returns None → `raise HTTPException(401)` inside try → Python walks except handlers → evaluates `jwt.ExpiredSignatureError` (ok) then `jwt.JWTError` → AttributeError → uvicorn 500. Reproduction: (1) login → get token, (2) POST /api/seed, (3) GET /api/pausas-activas with old Bearer token → 500 (should be 401). Mitigation: change to `except jwt.PyJWTError:` and add `except HTTPException: raise` immediately after the try body's exception classes, so intentional 401s propagate and PyJWT decode errors are caught correctly.
